subject: maths
question: A and B working together can complete a work in 30 days. A alone can complete the same work in 50 days. In how many days can B alone do the same work?
solution:
Given:

A and B working together can complete a work in 30 days. 

A alone can complete the same work in 50 days. 

Concept used:

Total work = Efficiency (Work done per day) × Total time taken

Calculation:

LCM (30, 50) = 150

Let the total work be 150 units.

Efficiency of A = 150/50 = 3 units

Efficiency of A and B together = 150/30 = 5 units

So, efficiency of B = 5 - 3 = 2 units 

Now, B will alone do the work in = 150/2

⇒ 75 days

∴ B alone do the same work in 75 days.
